v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Cor contrítum * et humiliátum, Deus, non despícies.
text.en: A contrite and a humbled heart, * O God, thou wilt not despise.

text.la: Propter nomen tuum, * Dómine, vivificábis me in æquitáte tua.
text.en: For thy name's sake, * O Lord, thou wilt quicken me in thy justice.

text.la: Deus, tu convérsus * vivificábis nos, et plebs tua lætábitur in te.
text.en: Thou wilt turn, O God, * Thou wilt quicken us and bring us to life.

text.la: Cum irátus fúeris, * Dómine, misericórdiæ recordáberis.
text.en: When thou art angry, * O Lord, thou wilt remember mercy.

text.la: Lauda * Deum tuum, Sion, qui annúntiat iudícia sua Israël.
text.en: Praise thy God, * O Sion, who declareth his judgments to Israel.

text.la: Clama, ne cesses, quasi tuba exálta vocem tuam, et annúntia pópulo meo scélera eórum, et dómui Iacob peccáta eórum.
text.en: Cry, cease not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and show my people their wicked doings, and the house of Jacob their sins.

v.la: Ángelis suis Deus mandávit de te.
v.en: God hath given His Angels charge over thee.

r.la: Ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
r.en: To keep thee in all thy ways.

text.la: Angelus Dómini * descendébat de cælo, et movebátur aqua, et sanabátur unus.
text.en: The Angel of the Lord * came down from heaven and the water was troubled, and one was made whole.

text.la: Esto, Dómine, propítius plebi tuæ: et, quam tibi facis esse devótam, benígno réfove miserátus auxílio.
text.en: Be gracious unto thy people, O Lord, and in thy mercy help all such as Thou hast called to be thine.

text.la: Vestri capílli cápitis omnes numeráti sunt: nolíte timére: multis passéribus melióres estis vos.
text.en: Even the very hairs of your head are all numbered: fear not therefore; ye are of more value than many sparrows.

v.en: The saints shall rejoice in glory:

r.en: They shall be joyful in their beds.

text.la: Præsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut, qui gloriósos Mártyres fortes in sua confessióne cognóvimus, pios apud te in nostra intercessióne sentiámus.
text.en: Grant, we beseech thee, O Almighty God, that we who know thy glorious Martyrs to have been in their testimony leal and true towards thee, may, now that they are with thee, feel them to be in their petitions pitiful towards us.
